source: Poly Haven (https://polyhaven.com) — all assets CC0 1.0 Universal (public domain, no attribution required; credited anyway).
processing: Official 1k glTF downloads (.gltf + .bin + JPEG textures), geometry untouched. JPEG textures over 200 KB re-encoded at 1024px, quality 62 (macOS sips) to keep each model under 2 MB. No Draco/meshopt/KTX2/WebP. Used by public/js/gelato.js.

assets.modified: textures re-encoded; transmissive glass swapped for a cheap transparent material at runtime

procedural: Everything else in the gelateria (display freezer, pans, gelato, cones, cups, dispensers, menu board, signage) is generated in code by gelato.js — no external assets.
